prompt_md: A snail at the bottom of a 10 m well climbs 3 m every day and slides back 2 m every night. On which day does it reach the top?
prompt_short: Snail in a 10 m well: up 3 m by day, down 2 m by night. Day it escapes?
hint_md: On its last day it doesn't slide back.
explain_intuition_md: It gains 1 m per full day, so after 7 days it starts at 7 m. On day 8 it climbs 3 m and is out before night can pull it down.
explain_math_md: Start of day $d$: height $d-1$. It escapes when $(d-1) + 3 \ge 10$, i.e. $d = 8$.
